references.text: Describes the death of Moses as the servant of the Lord, directly referred to in Joshua 1:1
Joshua is mentioned as Moses' servant, the same role described in Joshua 1:1
God commanded Moses to appoint Joshua as his successor, which is fulfilled in Joshua 1:1
Moses hands over leadership to Joshua and encourages him, serving as background for God's speech to Joshua
Joshua, son of Nun, was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him
Joshua is described as Moses' servant who did not leave the tent, the same servant role as in Joshua 1:1
Joshua, son of Nun, had been Moses' servant since his youth
Joshua is mentioned as the one who led the people into the land, but who did not give them the final rest
